verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details Gusto's payroll processing, off-cycle payrolls, contractor payments, and time-off request/approval APIs, but contains no documentation of hourly time entry capture or overtime calculation flowing into a payroll run. The only related mention is that Gusto integrates with third-party 'time tracking software' apps (gusto-docs-41), implying hourly time entry is handled outside Gusto rather than natively feeding payroll.
